topic.title: Asking the Agent a Question
topic.shortdesc: How to use a translation job to ask the agent a question about your content instead of translating it, and where to find its answer.

body.p: A translation job does not have to perform a translation. Because the agent reads your project and follows the instructions you provide, you can also use a job to ask a question about your content or translation setup and have the agent report back.

section.title: Asking a Question
section.p: Start a translation job as usual, but in the Instructions field, enter your question instead of translation guidance. Tell the agent not to translate anything, and specify where it should place its answer:

ul.li: In a file in your workspace - Ask the agent to write its answer to a file, such as a Markdown report. When the job finishes, bring its results into your workspace and open the file. See Reviewing Translations Before You Commit.
In the execution log - Ask the agent to write its answer to the log. Open the log by using View log on the job card. See Following and Managing a Translation Job.

section.title: Examples
section.p: Enter each of the following examples in the Instructions field of a new job:

p.codeblock: Do not translate anything. List every topic whose French translation uses a term found in .contentfusion/i18n/forbidden-terms.md, and write the list to report.md.
Do not translate anything. Summarize the structural differences between the en/ and de-DE/ versions of the User Guide publication, and print the summary to the log.

Do not translate anything. Audit this English documentation corpus and identify terms or expressions that lack a suitable dictionary translation into Romanian or whose literal translation would sound unnatural in technical usage. For each term, provide the source term, the recommended translation, and a brief justification. Write one term per line in `terms.txt`.

Do not translate anything. Report the translation status of the selected publications for each of the selected target languages: how many topics are missing, how many are stale, and how many are current. If the number is bigger than 25, approximate to 25. Write the report to translation-status.md, with one table per publication.

body.p: Asking a question runs the same agent as a translation job and is subject to the same review discipline. Read anything the agent writes into your workspace before you commit it. See Data Handling and Your Responsibilities.
